# QA Plan: Sprint 001 — Y1-P0 Stabilize
**Date**: 2026-10-18
**Generated by**: /qa-plan
**Scope**: 30 sprint items across 11 systems (32 in `production/sprint-status.yaml`, minus T01 done and S01 this planning work)
**Engine**: Godot 4.6 (installed 4.6.3), GDScript
**Sprint File**: `production/sprints/sprint-001.md` · status `production/sprint-status.yaml`
**qa.level**: full (per-system coverage targets included)

> **Inputs and gaps (read first)**
> - **No story files.** Items are Y1-P0 tasks (user decision 2026-10-18); acceptance criteria come from the
>   sprint plan, test detail from each task's steps and edge cases in `production/plan/_source/Y1-P0.json`.
> - **Every Type is inferred**, not declared. Declare it when `/dev-story` creates each story file.
> - **No GDD feeds this sprint.** `design/gdd/` holds only `game-concept.md`; no systems index, no control
>   manifest. No Edge Cases or Formulas sections exist, so edge-case coverage below comes from the plan's
>   own edge-case lists. Where a number depends on a pending user decision (T03, T07, T11), it is marked
>   **[decision]** and the test asserts the decided value, not a guessed one.
> - **Test runner.** Today: custom headless `extends SceneTree` suites run by
>   `AethelgardPrototype/tests/run_all_tests.ps1` with the `_check(cond, name)` pattern; not gdUnit4. T02
>   creates `tests/unit/` and `tests/integration/`. All paths below are relative to `AethelgardPrototype/`.
> - **No performance budget** is defined in `project.yaml` (only the 1280×720 run resolution). The smoke
>   check records frame time but has no pass/fail threshold until one is set.
> - **Watch it fail.** Every new regression check is run against the unfixed code first and seen failing
>   (`.claude/rules/test-standards.md`). Record the failing run in the task's evidence.
> - **Screenshot truth (AGENTS.md).** Every screenshot states whether it is a live viewport or a
>   headless/dummy-renderer capture. Visual/UI acceptance needs live viewport captures.

## Automated Tests Required

### T02 Move the tests into tests/unit and tests/integration — Integration (tooling)
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/meta/test_layout_test.gd` (or a guard inside `load_all_test`)
**What to test**:
- No `*_test.gd` sits directly under `tests/`; every suite is under `tests/unit/<system>/` or `tests/integration/<system>/`
- Every moved `*_test.gd` has its `.uid` beside it (baseline 2026-10-18: 223 `.uid`, 0 orphans)
- `run_all_tests.ps1` (full, not `-Quick`) passes 9/9 with the **same check counts as before the move**
  (record the pre-move counts first: e.g. phase0 73, chapter1 33+7, chapter2 49, context 33, dialogue 47,
  input 52, combat 10, reach 21, load_all 206)
- CI runs the 9 suites at their new `res://` paths and is green
- `tests/run_screenshots.ps1 -Only main_menu` still finds its runner

**Edge cases to cover**:
- A `.uid` left behind → Godot reports a broken uid on import (run `--headless --import`, grep the output)
- `tests/Unit` vs `tests/unit` must not both exist (Windows case-insensitivity)
- `run_tests.sh` with no argument still resolves its default suite (the phase0 CI step)
- Fixtures referenced by a relative path from a suite now one level deeper

**Estimated test count**: ~3 guard checks + the 9-suite parity run

### S02 Replacement Ch1 text — Config/Data
**Test file path**: existing `tests/unit/dialogue/dialogue_test.gd` (after T02)
**What to test**: `shatter.dlg` parses; voice lint passes (questions end in `?`, no banned tics, no hardcoded key names, speakers registered, rhythm rules); three nodes exist for kill, spare and purge
**Edge cases to cover**: no `412`, `iterations` or `at the bridge` in any line; objective strings fit the tracker at 1280 px (manual check)
**Estimated test count**: covered by the existing lint suites + 1 node-presence check

### S03 Conventional Commits hook and CI — Integration (tooling)
**Test file path**: a shell test beside the hook, e.g. `.githooks/test_commit_msg.sh` (location to settle in S03)
**What to test**:
- Rejects `stuff`; accepts `chore: add commit-msg hook`
- Accepts each of `feat|fix|chore|docs|test|refactor`, with and without a `(scope)`
- Body-line rule: `Task:` / `Story:` id as specified in S03 **[decision: required or optional]**
- CI job checks PR commit subjects against the same pattern and is green

**Edge cases to cover**: merge commits and revert commits pass; the hook runs under Git Bash on Windows (LF endings, executable bit)
**Estimated test count**: ~8 message cases

### S04 Repo hygiene — Integration (infra)
**Test file path**: none new; uses the full suite from the fresh clone
**What to test**: a `git clone` (not a copy) at the new path runs `--headless --import` cleanly and passes `run_all_tests.ps1` in full; `git lfs track` lists the decided patterns; `load_all` passes from a second fresh clone after LFS
**Edge cases to cover**: `.import` files holding absolute OneDrive paths (grep for `OneDrive`); paths over 260 characters at the new location; CI cache keyed on the pre-LFS checkout; Claude Code started in the new folder loads hooks and `CLAUDE.md`
**Estimated test count**: 0 new; 2 full-suite runs

### T04 Shatter scene rewire — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/story/chapter1_route_test.gd` (extended)
**What to test**:
- Kill, spare and purge routes each play their own `shatter.dlg` node
- Purge no longer falls into the spared branch (uses the real purge flag from `dialogue/ch1/aldric.dlg`)
- No played line contains `412`, `iterations` or `at the bridge`, on any route

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Old save with neither flag set → a defined default node plays, no crash
- Purge confirmation cancelled, then spare chosen → only the spare flag is set
- Hold-to-skip the cutscene → the same flags are set as watching it

**Estimated test count**: ~7 checks

### T05 Ch1 breadcrumbs — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/story/chapter1_route_test.gd` (extended)
**What to test**: at each of the 10 route steps (crash site → Elara → Broken Mile → Oakhaven gate → stew → afternoon → north field → bridge → Aldric → village meeting) the breadcrumb text equals the approved S02 string; each arrow target resolves to a node that exists in that scene
**Edge cases to cover**: the alarm firing early (walking to the north field or the bridge) jumps the objective with it; loading a save mid-afternoon shows the right objective without replaying
**Estimated test count**: 10 text + ~10 target + 2 edge = ~22 checks

### T06 Side quests completable — Logic + Integration
**Test file paths**: `tests/unit/quests/side_quest_rewards_test.gd`; `tests/integration/quests/act1_quests_completable_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- Unit: every reward id of all 14 `SideQuestManager` quests resolves to an `Inventory` item def, charm or ability (incl. `memory_crystal`, `forge_heart`, `null_heal_potion`, `arena_veteran`, `stabilizer_mk2`, `memory_shard`, `data_ore`, `developer_insight`, `echo_sense`, `lyra_power_shot`) per the T03 mapping **[decision]**
- Unit: `grant_rewards` with an unknown id raises one `push_error` naming the quest and grants nothing silently
- Unit: `ironhold_arena_legend` reaches step 5 through the bracket its quest text names
- Integration: each Act 1 quest (incl. `oakhaven_lost_memories`, `oakhaven_corrupted_cellar`, `oakhaven_herbalist_favor`, `oakhaven_memory_herb_delivery`) starts, advances and completes through the **real hooks**, not direct `advance_quest` calls; the quest HUD shows completion; rewards land exactly once; re-talking to Garro/Iris does not restart

**Edge cases to cover**: complete, save, load → reward not granted twice; quest started in Ch1 carried into Ch2 after the region change; inventory full when a reward item is granted; old save referencing a removed item
**Estimated test count**: ~14 unit (one per quest) + ~3 unit edge + ~8 integration

### T07 NG+ buff stacking — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/ngplus/ngplus_buff_stacking_test.gd`
**What to test**: simulate 3 NG+ cycles with the same choice flags → attack, defense and max_hp after cycles 2 and 3 equal cycle 1 under the approved rule **[decision]**; log the before/after numbers
**Edge cases to cover**: an older save that already stacked buffs (clamp-on-load vs leave, per the recorded decision); NG+ from the Chapter 3 ending path vs the Chapter 10 ending path; zero choice buffs (no flags set) → stats unchanged
**Estimated test count**: ~5 checks

### T08 Flashes, fragment_4, null_potion — Logic (secondary Visual/Feel)
**Test file paths**: `tests/unit/items/null_potion_consistency_test.gd`; flash and achievement checks in an existing integration suite or `tests/unit/achievements/` (settle in T08)
**What to test**:
- One frame after the shared flash helper is called, the flash node exists, is visible and has alpha > 0
- `fragment_4` unlocks at the chosen fragment count **[decision]** and not one before
- The three `null_potion` definitions (`ch1_oakhaven_village.gd:42`, `inventory_system.gd:80`, `shop_system.gd:56`) agree on description and effect

**Edge cases to cover**: flash during hitstop or pause does not freeze on screen; a save that unlocked `fragment_4` at 2 fragments keeps it; the TODO for the future reduce-flash option is present and linked
**Estimated test count**: ~6 checks

### T09 Remove unused autoloads — Config/Data
**What to test**: `project.godot` has 30 autoloads instead of 32; `load_all_test` and both route suites pass; `git grep -n "InteractionPrompt\|ObjectPool"` shows no runtime caller
**Edge cases to cover**: a `.tscn` that instances `interaction_prompt.gd` directly; export presets that list the files explicitly
**Estimated test count**: 0 new; 3 suite runs + 1 grep

### T10 Log spam, `_bound_texts`, leaked RID — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/input/input_bound_texts_prune_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- Bind 1,000 labels, free them, refresh → `_bound_texts.size() == 0`
- Each missing art slot warns once per run (`_warned_slots`); warning count over a full `chapter1_route` run before/after is recorded
- Exit leak: a **real-renderer** boot with `--verbose`, quit from the main menu, has no "RID allocations … leaked at exit" line (manual run, log saved; headless cannot show this)

**Edge cases to cover**: weak refs to nodes freed in the same frame as the refresh; the leak only after a scene that uses a cached atlas (test a plain boot and the screenshot-tour exit)
**Estimated test count**: ~3 unit checks + 1 warning-count comparison

### T11 Combat-feel leftovers — Integration (secondary Visual/Feel)
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/combat/combat_fixes_test.gd` (+4 checks)
**What to test**:
- Dash invulnerability lasts the approved window **[decision]** (today measured ~0.41 s vs `DASH_DURATION` 0.18), via a named constant
- One sword hit produces exactly one hit-SFX request
- Killing the last enemy gives a 0.12 time scale for ≥ 1 frame and returns to 1.0 within 0.2 s
- All hitstop requests go through `CombatFX` → `ContextStack.request_time_scale(&"hitstop")`; no parallel path

**Edge cases to cover**: dash into a hit on the last i-frame; the last enemy dies from a DoT while paused; two enemies die on the same frame; a hitstop request during Root Access slow-time
**Estimated test count**: 4 core + ~4 edge checks

### S08 Elara's house and the shrine — Integration (secondary Visual)
**Test file paths**: `chapter1_route_test` (enter/exit); `reachability_test` (room interactables); screenshot tour entries
**What to test**: entering and leaving each room returns the player to the right door with the afternoon or post-Aldric sequence intact; each stew question is asked once; Fragment One fires in the shrine with flags unchanged; the shrine dressing follows kill/spare/purge; save/load inside each room works or saving is blocked, with a correct return point
**Edge cases to cover**: entering the house before the stew invite; leaving the shrine before Fragment One finishes; gamepad focus after the room's dialogue
**Estimated test count**: ~10 checks

### T12 UI and region leftovers — UI (secondary Integration)
**Test file paths**: a check in `context_stack_test` or a new UI suite for the version labels; `reachability_test`; `dialogue_test` (runtime speaker lint)
**What to test**:
- Main menu and pause labels read the same `application/config/version` string
- `pre_boss` is in `reachability_test` targets, and the route test sees `pre_boss` before the Minute Hand
- No lore title reaches the dialogue speaker slot (lint covers the runtime calls)
- The unreachable Ironhold fallback branch is gone (no caller)

**Edge cases to cover**: the exported build's version label equals the editor's; the stats card with a very long region or flag name; the player dashes past the `pre_boss` trigger in one frame
**Estimated test count**: ~6 checks

### T14a / T14b Playthrough bot to the credits — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/playthrough/full_playthrough_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- T14a: legs from the Chapter 3 exit through Chapters 4–10 to the credits, auto-advancing dialogue and taking the first choice
- After each scene: `DialogueManager.is_active == false` and ContextStack is empty
- Any wait over 30 s fails with the scene name and the last dialogue node (stall detector)
- T14b: adds the Ch1 fight legs, completes New Game → credits, `CreditsScreen` finished and `ng_plus_unlocked` set; registered as a Long suite in `run_all_tests.ps1` (skipped by `-Quick`) and in `ci.yml`; wall time recorded

**Edge cases to cover**: timed sequences (medicine convoy, bridge) on the default path; a scene awaiting a real-time timer longer than the test timeout; credits skipped vs watched

### T13a–c Slime, guardian, boar fights — Integration (secondary Visual/Feel)
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/story/chapter1_route_test.gd` (scripted combat driver: damage the enemy to 0 through its API)
**What to test (each fight)**:
- The fight route loads the arena, resolves, and returns to the same spot with the same story flags as before the change
- The non-combat alternatives never load the arena (guardian: filter / aggression edits; boar: calm / rebuild nest)

**Edge cases to cover**: pausing mid-charge in the boar fight; dying to the slime at 1 HP during its death animation; the bridge deadline keeps running while the boar is handled; gamepad-only play (manual)
**Estimated test count**: ~6 checks per fight, ~18 total

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before any QA hand-off for this sprint (`/smoke-check sprint`):

1. The game launches to the main menu without a crash, in the editor and in the exported build
2. New Game reaches Kaelen under player control at the crash site
3. Ch1 route through the shatter scene on each of kill / spare / purge (T04)
4. Act 1 side quests complete and rewards land once (T06)
5. Pause, map and menus open and close through ContextStack (the only pause writer, guarded)
6. One arena fight (Ch1 slime) enters, resolves and returns (T13)
7. Clock Tower: `pre_boss` plays before the Minute Hand (T12)
8. Save / load mid-Ch1 and after a quest completion: no data loss, no double reward
9. The bot reaches the credits; NG+ unlocks; an NG+ start keeps stats equal to cycle 1 (T07, T14)
10. Exit without a leaked RID line (T10)
11. Frame time recorded on the dev machine; **no budget defined**, so no pass/fail threshold

| Item | Playtest Goal | Min Sessions | Target Player Type |
|-------|--------------|--------------|-------------------|

| T15 Phase 0 exit | Can a human finish New Game → credits on the exported build with 0 softlocks? | 1 (2 days) | You, keyboard then gamepad |

**Sign-off requirement**: playtest notes go to `production/qa/playtest-[sprint]-[topic].md` (tracked;
`production/session-logs/` is gitignored, so the skill's default path would not be kept), reviewed by
you before the item is marked complete. T13 and T11 sessions are advisory: you decide if they are needed.

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

An item is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (screenshot, video, or playtest notes with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration items, and was **seen failing** against the unfixed code
- [ ] Retained screenshot of each screen touched, in `production/qa/evidence/`, for all Visual/Feel and UI items, each labelled live viewport or headless
- [ ] Signed-off evidence doc at `production/qa/evidence/[item-slug]-evidence.md` for all Visual/Feel items (T08, T11, T13)
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions introduced (full `run_all_tests.ps1`, not only `-Quick`, before closing a code item)
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` or documented peer review)
- [ ] Item marked complete via `/story-done` (once a story file exists) and in `production/sprint-status.yaml`
